text:
Jules (Sales): ACME asks for a short-term resize of their Dedicated POC pool ded-poc-acme-07. Current min_capacity=24, burst_window=90m. Request: min_capacity=8, burst_window=20m, ephemeral burst credits=100 for demo window. Also need an ephemeral API key TTL=48h restricted to their VPC IPs. Can we do this without breaking contract? Need yes/no by EOD.

Naveen (Infra): Reservation contract needs 24h notice for committed min_capacity changes. We can implement an ephemeral overlay (quota overlay) for the demo that does not modify the underlying commit but allows lower visible min_capacity and attaches ephemeral credits. Billing exposure: overage will apply to ephemeral usage.

Rina (Eng): Suggested pool patch:
{"min_capacity":"8","burst_window":"20m","cooldown":"12m","ephemeral_credits":"100","fallback_route":"hosted-small"}
Set alerting >75% for 5m -> page on-call.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket POC-6001. Status: awaiting-sales-approval.

alex-acme (ACME): Confirm we accept potential overage charges for the demo and TTL=48h for the key with VPC IP allowlist.

Jules (Sales): Sales approves ephemeral credits and billing exposure for the demo only. Proceed.

Naveen (Infra): Implementation plan:
1) Create ephemeral API key name "acme-poc-ephemeral" TTL=48h, bind to ACME VPC IP range.
2) Apply ephemeral quota overlay to ded-poc-acme-07 at T-2h before demo.
3) Configure fallback to hosted-small and set cooldown 12m.
Rollback snippet:
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/dedicated/pools/ded-poc-acme-07 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"min_capacity":24,"burst_window":"90m","cooldown":"30m"}'

ops-bot: [automated] POC-6001 scheduled. Change window: 2026-04-10T09:00Z -> 2026-04-10T11:00Z.

alex-acme (ACME): Thanks team, all good on our side.
